findings.title: Literal row-shaped wrapping suppresses genuine amount/dependent tails
findings.root: complete_value_row accepts one text cell without sentence-terminal punctuation followed by literal scalars. That text cell can itself be a real wrapped clause. Triage vetoes a pair before honoring its observed dependent/amount tail.
examples:
The installed production equipment generated revenue of
12.4

million dollars and remains subject to customer acceptance
125
160

The other matters are still being examined
125
160

which are subject to customer acceptance
175
200
findings.actual: Both pairs have complete_value_row=True on each side, but triage returns pages=(), reasons=() while the source amount/dependency remains explicit.
findings.expected: Preserve a conservative gap for real amount/dependent prose. Literal value-cell presence plus one arbitrary text cell cannot prove that prose is a nominal row label.
findings.bounded_repair: At the physical-demand owner, do not allow the literal row-pair veto to erase actual dependent/amount evidence without stronger positive structural disposition; retain complete nominal-row negatives and mixed/one-sided-row positives. Reuse existing evidence, not new company/finance words or a second business classifier.
